title: 第22章  爆头你还能认出来？
novel_title: 人在镇魔司，红词加身只杀不渡
content_zh:
不过两个呼吸，陆渊已经站了起来。

    吐出一嘴血沫，身上的伤口已经变成了浅红的疤痕，并且正在肉眼可见的速度变淡。

    气血还在体内运转，继续冲刷着深层的暗伤。

    那些震裂的经络，破碎的筋膜，都在气血冲刷之下极速恢复。

    尸魔走出山神庙，血色眸光落在陆渊身上，发出沙哑声音。

    “你的血......很特别，我很喜欢！我改主意了，今天你必须死！”

    “用嘴把我念死是吧？”陆渊语气不屑。

    尸魔没有啰嗦，直接扑杀过来。

    这一次陆渊没有硬接，闪身向一旁避开，手中晶刺瞬间凝结，但并没有着急射出。

    以前的晶刺只是沾染了【开天】特性，而此刻，他正在将开天之力灌入晶刺。

    很快，晶刺表面浮现出一缕若有若无的红芒。

    嗖！

    破空声响，如同一道红色闪电。

    【开天】之下，尸魔鳞甲出现裂痕，晶刺钉入它右边肩胛，被骨骼卡住。

    尸魔发出一声怒吼，也不知是否疼痛，但它右臂的动作出现了明显的迟滞。

    陆渊没有冒进，脚下飞退，继续拉扯。

    掌心晶芒极速凝结，这一次，晶刺表面又多了一缕红芒。

    嗖！

    第二道晶刺钉入同一位置，尸魔右肩猛地一颤，鳞甲大片破碎，黑色脓血从伤口涌出。

    “该死！你竟敢伤我！”

    尸魔怒吼，探爪抓来，泛着乌光的利爪直刺陆渊心口。

    陆渊没有躲。

    噗嗤！

    利爪刺穿他的胸膛，黑色指甲切开皮肉，刺破骨骼，只差一寸，就能将那颗跳动的心脏捏碎。

    然而这时，一道手臂粗的锋棱晶刺已经抵在尸魔面门。

    晶刺表面，丝丝缕缕红芒闪烁幻灭，其中溢出的破灭气息比之前任何一道还要恐怖。

    “你——”

    尸魔眼中红光巨颤。

    陆渊没再给它说话的机会。

    猛地打出晶刺。

    砰！

    声音很轻，像戳破一张纸。

    然后，贯穿头颅，从脑后穿出。

    那张面目全非的脸彻底消失，只剩一个拳头大小的窟窿。

    尸魔身躯僵住了。
content_en:
Within two breaths, Lu Yuan had already stood up.

    He spat out a mouthful of blood, and the wounds on his body had turned into light red scars, which were fading at a speed visible to the naked eye.

    Qi and blood are still circulating in the body, continuing to wash away the deep hidden wounds.

    Those cracked meridians and broken fascia were all restored quickly under the wash of Qi and blood.

    The corpse demon walked out of the mountain temple, his bloody eyes fell on Lu Yuan, and he made a hoarse voice.

    "Your blood... is very special, I like it very much! I changed my mind, you must die today!"

    "Tell me to death with your mouth, right?" Lu Yuan said in a disdainful tone.

    The corpse demon didn't hesitate and came directly to kill him.

    This time, Lu Yuan didn't take a hard hit, and ducked aside. The crystal thorns in his hand condensed instantly, but he didn't rush to shoot out.

    In the past, the crystal thorn was only contaminated with the characteristics of [Opening the Sky], but at this moment, he was pouring the power of opening the sky into the crystal thorn.

    Soon, a faint red light appeared on the surface of the crystal thorn.

    Whoosh!

    The sound cracked through the air, like a red lightning bolt.

    Under [Open Sky], cracks appeared in the scales of the corpse demon, and the crystal thorns were driven into its right shoulder blade and got stuck by the bones.

    The corpse demon let out a roar. It was unclear whether it was in pain, but the movement of its right arm showed obvious lag.

    Lu Yuan did not advance rashly, but flew back and continued to pull.

    The crystal light in the palm condensed rapidly, and this time, there was another ray of red light on the surface of the crystal thorn.

    Whoosh!

    The second crystal spike penetrated the same position, and the corpse demon's right shoulder trembled violently. Large pieces of its scales were shattered, and black pus and blood gushes out from the wound.

    "Damn it! How dare you hurt me!"

    The corpse demon roared and clawed at Lu Yuan's heart with its gleaming black claws.

    Lu Yuan did not hide.

    Poof!

    The sharp claws pierced his chest, and the black nails cut through the flesh and pierced the bones, leaving only an inch to crush the beating heart.

    However, at this time, a sharp crystal thorn as thick as an arm was pressed against the zombie demon's face.

    On the surface of the crystal thorn, wisps of red light flickered and disillusioned, and the aura of destruction that overflowed from it was more terrifying than any before.

    "You——"

    The corpse demon's eyes were red and trembling.

    Lu Yuan didn't give it another chance to speak.

    Shoot out the crystal thorn violently.

    Bang!

    The sound was very soft, like breaking a piece of paper.

    Then, penetrate the skull and exit from the back of the head.

    The unrecognizable face completely disappeared, leaving only a hole the size of a fist.

    The corpse demon's body froze.
title_en: Chapter 22 Can you still recognize a headshot?
